source: Dinner picks from Resy's 2025 Nashville top-10 (Dec 2025); restaurant coordinates from latlong.net Nashville POI lists; sight coordinates from latitude.to, Mapcarta and Nashville Sites

spots.name: Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
spots.blurb: Big museum of country music history, from costumes and guitars to Elvis's gold Cadillac
spots.blurbEs: Gran museo de la historia de la música country, con trajes, guitarras y el Cadillac dorado de Elvis

spots.name: Ryman Auditorium
spots.blurb: The historic "Mother Church of Country Music," open for daytime tours
spots.blurbEs: La histórica "Mother Church of Country Music", con recorridos durante el día

spots.name: Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park
spots.blurb: State park below the Capitol with a Tennessee history walk and carillon
spots.blurbEs: Parque estatal al pie del Capitolio con un recorrido por la historia de Tennessee y un carillón

spots.name: The Parthenon
spots.blurb: Full-scale replica of the Athens Parthenon with a 42-foot Athena inside
spots.blurbEs: Réplica a escala real del Partenón de Atenas con una Atenea de 42 pies en su interior

spots.name: Nashville Zoo at Grassmere
spots.blurb: Large zoo on a historic farm with giraffes, red pandas and a big playground
spots.blurbEs: Gran zoológico en una granja histórica con jirafas, pandas rojos y un parque infantil grande
